title: AI Film Production
summary: End-to-end short films and brand narratives built with generative production — directed, not assembled.
body: From the first logline to the final grade, I direct AI-generated films with the same discipline as a live-action set: motivated shots, continuity, performance, and a reason for every cut. The result is cinema, not a collection of impressive clips.

title: AI Commercial Production
summary: Scroll-stopping commercials produced at a fraction of traditional cost — without looking like it.
body: Product worlds, impossible camera moves, and talent-safe scenes, built for paid social and broadcast. I handle the full pipeline, from concept and boards to platform-ready cutdowns in every ratio.

title: Cinematic Video Editing
summary: Edit, colour, sound, and finish for footage that already exists — elevated into something worth watching.
body: The edit is where the film is truly written. I bring pacing, structure, and emotional control to documentaries, interviews, commercials, and long-form content, then finish with a colour grade and sound pass that makes it feel theatrical.

title: AI Storytelling & Scene Creation
summary: Worlds, performances, and moments that could not exist on a traditional budget.
body: Historical reconstructions, speculative futures, impossible locations. I use AI to build scenes with narrative purpose — grounded in research and visual references so they feel real, not synthetic.

title: AI Character & Environment Creation
summary: Consistent characters and believable environments, built as a reusable visual system.
body: One-off generations are easy. Consistency is the craft. I build character bibles, environment libraries, and prompt systems that keep faces, wardrobe, and lighting coherent across an entire campaign or series.

title: Complete AI Video Production
summary: One partner from blank page to final upload — strategy, production, post, and delivery.
body: The full service, without the agency layers. I lead the creative, build the pipeline, direct the production, and deliver finished work ready for every channel. You get a director, not a production line.

title: Creative Direction & Story Development
summary: The thinking before the frames — concept, audience, narrative, and commercial intent.
body: Sometimes you do not need a video. You need clarity. I help teams find the story worth telling, shape it for the audience that matters, and build a visual direction the whole campaign can live inside.
